subject: Proposition 2 1/2 Override Campaign Kickoff
overview: Cristina McGorty delivered remarks at a campaign kickoff event advocating for the Proposition 2 1/2 override ballot initiatives to fund Medford schools, the DPW, and a fire headquarters. Attendees were encouraged to volunteer, donate to the campaign, and vote yes.

items.title: Remarks by Cristina McGorty
items.summary: Cristina McGorty shared her personal experience as a public school educator and urged support for the Proposition 2 1/2 override to address underfunding in Medford schools, the DPW, and fire headquarters construction.
